metric.definition: Capacity in permitting, planned, or under construction per market, the standard unit for comparing data center booms across regions.

reading.body:
Construction pipeline in megawatts tracks capacity in permitting, planned, or under construction per market, described as the standard unit for comparing data center booms across regions.

Announced megawatts are named as the leading indicator for land, power, and equipment demand, but the site is explicit that the published numbers come almost entirely from commercial research firms, and it links to who publishes them rather than republishing figures it cannot independently verify. That distinction, between tracking a number and vouching for it, matters because construction pipeline figures are the most speculative and least audited of the metrics in this collection, closer to industry forecasting than to the SEC-filed capital expenditure data tracked elsewhere in this set.

No sibling metrics are listed for this one, which sets it apart from every other metric in this collection, all of which are grouped with related measurements.
